description: This file defines the SearchFormMetaParser class, which extends MetaParser to parse and process search form metadata in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for parsing HTML content, merging sections, processing sections to extract form elements, and applying rules to search form data.

classes.name: SearchFormMetaParser
classes.description: A parser class for extracting and managing search form metadata in SuiteCRM. It extends MetaParser and provides methods for parsing HTML content, merging search section configurations, and applying specific rules to search form data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser, setting the view type to 'Search'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a search form metadata file, process layout sections, optionally merge with master layouts, and generate PHP code string defining the search layouts.

methods.name: mergeSection
methods.description: Merges a given search section array with a master layout, maintaining existing elements, and replacing matching elements with master layout versions.

methods.name: processSection
methods.description: Processes HTML table content representing a search section, extracting form element names, handling special form elements (like textarea), and assembling a structured array of form fields.

methods.name: applyRules
methods.description: Applies specific rules, such as overriding email fields, to a search section array, utilizing the BaseRule class.
